summary: BEFORE regenerate all 200: 162.53ms; AFTER changed+dependents walk: 169.01ms, 196/200 regenerated. The change (page_195) sat upstream of nearly the whole chain (page_i depends on page_{i+1}), so the dependent cone was ~98% of the graph. Lesson: selective regeneration's benefit = 1 - cone/total; place changes leaf-ward or the walk degrades to full regen. Technique sound, precondition documented.
